rotationPolicy.notes: Design may change after a visual demo is approved by the site owner. Factual class data must not be rewritten by a scheduled refresh. Once 30 approved designs exist, reuse oldest-first only after the minimum gap.

approvedDesigns.name: Class Map Editorial
approvedDesigns.layout: audience cards + learning-focus strip + learning format + five-step lesson flow + start CTA
approvedDesigns.visualLanguage: jade, cream and gold editorial cards with restrained Chinese seal motifs; no teacher portrait until a verified teacher image is supplied
approvedDesigns.responsive: four audience cards collapse to two and then one column; focus grid and process timeline become horizontally compact stacked cards on mobile
